newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH MUSIC TELEVISION HITS AIRWAVES APRIL 19.
newsitem.headline: POLISH MUSIC TELEVISION HITS AIRWAVES APRIL 19.

text.p: Polish Television (TVP) on April 19 will begin broadcasting the first-ever Polish-language music channel "Tylko Muzyka" (Only Music), which will be available on cable television, TVP said on Friday.

Joanna Bancerowska, a TVP spokeswoman, told Reuters that more than half of the 24-hour station's programming would cover Polish music, with about 70 percent pop, 20 percent jazz and classical, and 10 percent folk and children's music.
The music station, which would eventually be self-financing, was expected to be the first of five or six theme channels which Polish television would launch on cable television.
Bancerowska said the channel's revenues would come primarily from advertising, sponsored programming and fees from cable operators.
